title: Anki Ease-Factor Drift
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vocab:review ease_factor=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(ease_factor) as avg_ease by _time deck
| sort 0 _time deck
description: Shows whether a deck's average ease factor is drifting down, signaling card difficulty or poor formulation.
value: Ease-factor drift is an early warning that a deck is becoming leech-heavy before due counts explode.
implementation: Capture ease factor in `vocab:review` events and trend monthly average by deck.
visualization: Line chart of average ease factor by deck.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when your flashcard deck is quietly getting harder and more frustrating over time.
